findings.title: Discovery and execution chain (find -exec)
findings.description: The find command with -exec executes commands on discovered files. An attacker can use this to find and execute hidden malicious scripts.
findings.snippet:
# Check Docker disk usage
docker system df

# Clean up unused resources
docker system prune -a

# Remove old act cache
find ~/.cache/act -type d -mtime +30 -exec rm -rf {} +
findings.remediation: Review the command sequence for potential multi-step attacks. Ensure all steps are necessary and safe.

findings.snippet:
set -euo pipefail

INPUT_VERSION="$ARGUMENTS"

# ━━━ PREREQUISITES VALIDATION ━━━

# Change to konflux-release-data repository
cd ~/konflux/konflux-release-data || {
  echo "❌ Error: konflux-release-data repository not found at ~/konflux/konflux-release-data"
  exit 1
}

# Verify repository structur
findings.remediation: Review the command sequence for potential multi-step attacks. Ensure all steps are necessary and safe.
